reuse.why: The change goes into the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate, which every schedule path (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange) already uses.

duplication.why: It is a two-line change in one shared predicate and nothing is copied.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts where the tree defines it.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Minimal and obvious. Any future holiday format change also lands in this single predicate.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No site matches holidays outside isWeekendOrHoliday.
